::: {.color3}
# what is nexus?
:::
::: {.section2}
***Nexus*** is Student Election Group preparing for the 2026 UNL ASUN Elections. 

We are currently in the recruiting phase until February 23rd when SEGs are permitted to begin visible campaigning.

I hope you consider joining ***Nexus***!

- *Kyanne Casperson, Nexus President*
:::
